name: fractional claims: a child already claimed through its sibling
description: out (1) reads a and b, and a (1) reads b (3). Every plan runs all three once, so the optimum is 5. Packing out's children, anchor a claims all of b's weight through its own claims, so b has no capacity left: neither as an anchor nor through the unclaimed fraction of its own weight may b add anything. Crediting b's own weight again (or exceeding a claim of 1 on b) would claim 8.
